scientific_integrity: The infinite-size result follows from an explicit finite-state stationary generator proof, moment tightness and uniqueness of the weak stationary Fokker–Planck solution. Finite numerical checks are not used as infinite proof. Historical originality is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Fixed real critical-window offset only; no mixing times, dynamic limit from arbitrary initial states, finite-n closed invariant formula or uniform c. Unindexed priority may remain.
title: Critical stationary half-Gaussian crossover in a source-pinned bipartite contact process
